summary: Admin-access review on 2026-09-22: the panel requires the Firebase-issued admin custom claim; Firestore rules independently restrict configuration changes, corrections, bracket creation, and audit reads. Client identity fields cannot grant roles. Demo administration is isolated in browser-local sample data. This assessment covers the admin authorization boundary, not a comprehensive security certification. All 14 Firestore emulator tests passed, including unauthorized audit reads, identity self-grants, and valid configuration writes by admins versus nonadmins. No production account roles were changed.
